propositions: Bug tickets must capture which detection channel found them (canary, CI, review-bot, human-audit, user-report, etc.) at creation time with zero user friction.
Automated filers set REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable; CLI agents pass optional --detected-by flag; the flag overrides the env var.
Detected-by value is normalized by strip() + lowercase; empty/whitespace-only becomes unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim (no enforced enum); create never fails validation.
process_create projects detected_by present-only into compiled state and ticket_state.schema.json; events without the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change state.
The env-var is read at the create_core seam so library (_lib_writes), MCP (_mcp_writes), and CLI filers all converge; Jira inbound reconciler intentionally bypasses it to avoid mis-attribution.
